Messages.Author: François
Messages.Body:
Hello everyone,

In last night's game, the following situation occured :

Tobias Smith attempts to diablerize. Gustavo Morales wakes and attempts
to block.
Tobias Smith plays tenebrous form superior : Gustavo burns a blood to
attempt to block, and gains intercept somehow : the action is blocked.
In combat, Tobias plays Shadow Body (combat ends and the action
continue). Gustavo is still under the effect of his wake : must he burn
another blood to attempt to block Tobias again ?

We ruled that he had to burn a blood again. Was it correct ?

Tenebrous Form
Type: Action Modifier
Requires: Obtenebration
Cost: 1 blood
[obt] +1 stealth.
[OBT] As above, and minions without Obtenebration must pay 1 blood to
attempt to block.

Thank you,

François

Messages.Body:

> attempt to block, and gains intercept somehow : the action is blocked.
> In combat, Tobias plays Shadow Body (combat ends and the action
> continue). Gustavo is still under the effect of his wake : must he burn
> another blood to attempt to block Tobias again ?
>
> We ruled that he had to burn a blood again. Was it correct ?

Yes. Card text would have to be "burn a blood to be able to attempt to block
for the remainder of the action" otherwise, as in Helena's text.

Messages.Author: David Zopf
Messages.Body:
"Wolflord" <jo.her...@sca.com> wrote in message
news:1136457129....@g47g2000cwa.googlegroups.com...

> Hey guys,
> Wow !Now there's a confusing answer (at least to me)
>

Simplest way to explain it; a continued action requires a new block
attempt. Unless your previous burn blood effect gives you the ability to
block for the duration of the action, its just a payment for a one-time
benefit.
